notes: Second attempt at the restaurant brief after the first one never published. This time the build was clean: home with name, hero and opening hours by weekday, a twelve-dish menu in three sections with prices, dietary markers and allergens on every dish, and a reservation form with date, time and party size. The reservation was accepted and answered with the reference SPK-4CD2E8. Address and phone are in the footer; the phone number is also a tap-to-call link in the reservation column.
